page.overview:
Who is Musashi?

Musashi is depicted as a large samurai clad in brown armor with several arrows stuck to his back. He attacks with a katana, being able to block attacks but moving slowly in exchange. When low on health, the blade on his katana breaks off. His name is based on Musashi Miyamoto.
